title: cracca subtriflora
intro: Cracca subtriflora, commonly known as Tick Trefoil, is a legume plant species native to South America. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with its reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cracca subtriflora are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
